title: L BREAK into program
statementMd:
Hack the [program](https://assets.codeforces.com/rounds/1505/l.z80) and get the password hidden in it.

## Input

This program has only one test, and it's empty (it doesn't give your program anything to read).

## Output

Output the password recovered from the program. The password is case sensitive.
statementZhMd:
破解这个[程序](https://assets.codeforces.com/rounds/1505/l.z80)，获取其中隐藏的密码。

## 输入格式

这个程序只有一个测试，且该测试为空（它不会向你的程序提供任何需要读取的内容）。

## 输出格式

输出从程序中恢复出的密码。密码区分大小写。
